chunks: Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, that he said:
"All iron is deliberate [killing/injury by a weapon]."

key_terms.الْحَدِيدِ: iron; a metal weapon or instrument used in injury or killing
key_terms.عَمْدٌ: intentional act; deliberate killing or injury in legal classification

ai.seo_question: In Shia fiqh, how is the use of iron classified in cases of diyat and qisas?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal principle in the law of diyat and qisas: the use of iron is treated as intentional violence. Its significance is in classifying cases of killing or injury for judicial rulings and legal liability.
